title: The stiffness switch, swept properly -- and my size numbers were wrong
question: With six seeds and three times the plants: is B still better? The size cost I reported last time does not exist, so this is now a pure look question.
context_md:
**You were right and I was wrong, so that first.** Last card I reported that the switch shrinks shrub by 45% and makes a grass plant twelve times bigger. That was **five founders on one seed**, and you called it: *"so much plant to plant variation"*.

Grass, biggest single plant, same five founders, six seeds:

| seed | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| off | 57 | 112 | 54 | 48 | 46 | 43 |
| on | **701** | 49 | 54 | 76 | 58 | 44 |

Seed 1 is a freak run. Every other seed is 43-112, median **51 -> 56**. My headline was one seed out of six.

**Swept over six seeds at three times the founders** (10 trees, 10 conifers, 12 shrubs, 16 grass), the size effect is not there:

| | cells, median off -> on | authored higher on |
|---|---|---|
| tree | 25,502 -> 25,915 | 4 of 6 |
| conifer | 35,052 -> 32,591 | 0 of 6 |
| shrub | 6,192 -> 5,738 | 2 of 6 |
| grass | 4,078 -> 3,912 | 2 of 6 |

Nothing wins on more than 4 of 6 and the ratios run 0.93-1.02. **So the switch is close to free**, which is the opposite of what I told you last time, and it makes this a pure question about how the plants look.

**The pictures:** three seeds across, four species down -- tree, conifer, shrub, grass. Same seeds, same founders, same binary; only the selector differs. The shrub row is worth a look for its own sake: seed 2 is nearly barren in both arms, which is the variation you were pointing at.

**What it is for.** The reed can only stand straight with this on, and a species cannot opt in by itself -- the selector forces 0 and never reads the file. So this decides whether the second water plant is a species file or an engine change.

items.label: A -- what ships today (switch off)
items.caption: Each species' authored stiffness ignored. Three seeds across; tree, conifer, shrub, grass.

items.label: B -- each species using the value in its own file
items.caption: Same seeds, same founders; only the selector differs.
